fold_consequence: Every IPA workflow (for example ios-ci.yml) requires canonical-source.json, embedded-core.patch and Rpcs3CoreABI.h to equal the commit of the prebuilt Core it installs: from this fold until a Core 611 built from this delta is pinned, no IPA can install the prebuilt Core 610.

behaviour.frame: rsx::thread::post_vblank_event calls the optional host callback after the guest VBlank event (RSX VBlank thread, 60 Hz, none while paused or stopped; it starts only once the game initialized RSX). One atomic load when nothing is attached; try_lock, never blocking the emulator.
behaviour.memory: vm::try_access page by page (4 KiB); unmapped or protected pages zero-filled; only while running or paused; never writes guest memory; exceptions contained.
behaviour.session_info: Effective Vblank Rate, Clocks scale and Frame limit (Hardcore-compatible only at 60 Hz, 100 %, bounded limit) and the base library entry of the last rpcs3_ios_boot_game (ISO or directory, never an update or a savestate).
behaviour.locks: No hook takes g_api_mutex or calls set_error().
